messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD-8742 (high error rate on model-catalog-service). Auto-escalation: page to +eng-oncall, +eng-sre. link: https://pd.example/PD-8742

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-8742 created by monitor catalog-config-check. Symptoms: 5xx spike on model-route resolution, tokenizer mismatch errors in logs, failing predictions for several customers. Severity: P1.

Maya: got the page, I'm oncall and looking. pinging runtime and s-re to triage.

Raj: acked. grabbing the most recent deploys. Seeing a config promotion at 2025-11-08T03:12Z that promoted a new model-revision mapping for model-id=tx-bert-3 -> revision r2025-11-08-1.

Lee: I'm in. initial glance: tokenizer config defaults for tx-bert-3 changed from "tokenizer: bpe-v1" to "tokenizer: hybrid-fallback" in the catalog promotion. Our compatibility table shows hybrid-fallback is only valid for rev >= r2025-11-09-2. That would explain the mismatch errors.

Olivia: adding runtime logs: excerpt:
```
2025-11-08T03:13:22Z ERROR model-resolver Failed to instantiate tokenizer: hybrid-fallback not compatible with weights rev r2025-11-08-1
2025-11-08T03:13:23Z WARN request-id=abc123 fallback to default-tokenizer -> tokenization drift
2025-11-08T03:13:24Z ERROR inference 5xx InvalidTokenizerConfig
```

Sam: Customer impact: support queue shows spike for ACME-analytics and VendorX integration. Several requests returned 500s and some embeddings clients saw broken token counts. Tracking open tickets: #1429, #1430.

Maya: immediate mitigation options: 1) roll catalog promotion back to previous mapping, 2) pin runtime to force use of bpe-v1 for that model, 3) emergency fallback to a compatible model variant in the routing layer. Which should we do fastest?

Raj: rollback promotion is simplest but takes ~3–5 min to propagate. pinning at routing layer can be immediate via `rcli` and doesn't require a catalog write. I can run pin now.

Lee: recommend pin + rollback. Pin to stable rev r2025-10-31-4 and revert promotion in catalog to prevent re-promote. Also add a temporary config check to block promotions that change tokenizer on active revisions.

Maya: Raj, run the pin. Lee, please prepare the rollback PR and I'll approve. Olivia, throttle new catalog promotions until we confirm. Sam, please update ACME-analytics & VendorX tickets with ETA and mitigation.

Raj: executing pin command: `rcli route pin --model tx-bert-3 --revision r2025-10-31-4 --reason "emergency: tokenizer incompatibility"`

pagerduty-bot: PD-8742 acknowledged by Raj.

Raj: pin applied at 2025-11-08T03:18:05Z. Routing now directs live traffic for tx-bert-3 -> r2025-10-31-4. Initial error rate dropping.

Olivia: I've disabled catalog-autopromote triggers for the catalog namespace and set a temporary hold. Logging: catalog-service accepted hold at 2025-11-08T03:18:40Z.

Maya: Lee, how long for rollback PR? We need to ensure the bad mapping is removed from the canonical catalog.

Lee: preparing PR with revert changelist. Will push in ~8 minutes for fast-track. Also adding an automated unit check to fail promotions that change tokenizer field without explicit compat flag.

Sam: updated ACME-analytics ticket: "Mitigation in progress: routing pinned to last-known-good revision; expected restoration of service within 10 minutes. If you see continued 500s, please send sample request-ids." Customer responded: "Thanks, will monitor."

Maya: monitoring metrics. Error rate went from 18% -> 2% after pin. Latency slightly increased for some requests but acceptable.

Lee: PR submitted: revert catalog promotion (PR #4218). Requesting fast-track review from config owners.

Raj: after pin I still see a small number of queued jobs hitting incompatible revs — likely from cached routes on long-lived workers. Running rolling restart on the worker pool for tx-bert-3: `kops rolling-restart workers -l app=tx-bert-3` to flush cached tokenizer instances.

Olivia: started rolling restarts at 2025-11-08T03:25:10Z. Progress: 3/12 nodes restarted.

Maya: escalation note: because PD auto-escalation threshold hit, Eng Dir oncall paged — tracking but not required yet if mitigation continues.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8742 escalated to Eng Director (auto-escalation).

Lee: PR merged at 2025-11-08T03:31:02Z and catalog reverted. Catalog-service now reports mapping for tx-bert-3 -> r2025-10-31-4.

Raj: rolling restart complete at 2025-11-08T03:37:45Z. No new InvalidTokenizerConfig errors observed in logs.

Maya: monitoring shows errors back to baseline. I'm going to acknowledge PD as mitigated and leave incident open for follow-up (postmortem + action items).

pagerduty-bot: PD-8742 status changed -> acknowledged by Maya.

Maya: Post-incident immediate actions: 1) Add yarn to fast-track: block tokenizer changes without compat flag (Lee). 2) Add canary rule: when catalog promotion changes tokenizer mapping, hold and run a quick local test harness before publish (Olivia). 3) Improve observability: surface tokenizer compatibility warnings in catalog UI/console (Raj). 4) Customer comms: Sam to send summary to impacted customers.

Sam: drafting customer note now, will send within 30 min.

Lee: creating follow-up tickets: INF-2108 (compatibility gate), INF-2109 (catalog promotion canary tests).

Maya: thanks team. I'll hand off to next oncall in 25 minutes with the incident context. If anything regresses, re-open PD or ping me directly.

Raj: quick remark — we should also evaluate why the promotion got past preflight checks. It came from a CI job labeled `autopromote/stage -> prod`; looks like the tokenizer change was part of a larger bundle and slipped through. I'll add stricter diff checks.

Olivia: noted. I'll add a temporary dashboard to track promotions that change tokenizer, quantization, or batch defaults.

Maya: closing notes: mitigated at 2025-11-08T03:38Z via routing pin + catalog revert + worker restart. PD remains for postmortem. I'll post a short summary to #incidents shortly. Good work. :thumbsup:

Sam: thanks everyone. I'll follow up on customer outreach and share the sent copy in the channel once done.

incident-bot: PD-8742 incident logged. Recommend scheduling postmortem and tagging owners.
